recommendations.name: Loft insulation top-up to 270 mm
recommendations.reason: The loft has 150 mm; topping up to 270 mm is cheap, quick, and cuts the heat every later measure has to supply.

recommendations.name: Cavity wall insulation
recommendations.reason: Unfilled cavity walls lose a lot of heat; filling them is quick and low cost.

recommendations.name: Double glazing (secondary glazing where listed or in a conservation area)
recommendations.reason: Old double glazing: replacing it saves a little for a high cost.

recommendations.name: Smart heating controls (smart thermostat with TRVs)
recommendations.reason: Heats rooms only when needed; cheap and quick, and it helps a later heat pump run efficiently.

recommendations.name: Air source heat pump
recommendations.reason: Replaces the boiler or heaters; gas use falls and electricity use rises. Best after insulation.

recommendations.name: Solar panels (2 to 3 kWp)
recommendations.reason: Cuts electricity bought from the grid; it does not change how much energy the home needs.

infeasible.reason: The walls are not uninsulated solid walls.
A solid floor needs digging out; not a practical retrofit.
